title: Arlo’s Early Warning System Gets a Big Upgrade in Arlo Secure 7
summary: Threat Assessment and Arlo Summary make Arlo’s AI security cameras even better. Find out how.
body_markdown:
Arlo Secure is our flagship security system: A robust tracking and Early Warning System that uses tools like machine learning and artificial intelligence to detect suspicious activity and notify you through the convenience of your smartphone.


Of course, many of Arlo’s security products work great without a subscription. Right out of the box, Arlo customers get a live view of all of their security feeds, basic motion detection alerts, 2-Way Audio, and even customizable Privacy Zones to protect your neighbors’ privacy.


When you sign up to Arlo Secure, you instantly get so much more, right at your fingertips. You’ll gain access to a rolling 60-Day Video History of your security footage, customizable Smart Activity Zones for capturing the most important elements of your feed, Priority Care from our support team, and even 24/7 Emergency Response and 24/7 Professional Monitoring with the Arlo Smart Secure and Ultra Secure plan.


But the heart of Arlo Secure is our powerful Early Warning System. It’ll allow your AI security camera to instantly recognize people, vehicles, packages, animals, sounds, even smoke alarms and fire, and notify you on your mobile device when it detects something important. And now, it’s even better in Arlo Secure 7.
